_doc: Exact tool names the agent may register from each MCP server (Hermes mcp_servers.<name>.tools.include). Read-only CRM and calendar lookups only. Every send, reply, create, update or delete happens in the relsend worker after a signed human approval, never through an agent tool. Exact names only (no globs): scripts/check_repo.py rejects globs and any name matching a deny pattern. Confirm live names with `python3 -m relcore doctor --mcp-surface` after connecting; a name that does not exist simply registers nothing.
